fixture_source: The same three byte-identical milai_odr_v19 fixtures and freezes used by A1; no changed public messages, gold hints or expanded data.
initial_acquisition: An ordinary Host search must really return X@1 and its body must enter an actual Provider request before the external update.
actual_projection: Reconcile each projected search item with its original search call and item index and the actual Provider wire. SUPERSEDED/DELETED historical bodies must be withheld; unaffected CURRENT/UNKNOWN items and array ordering remain unchanged. The old assistant prose may remain and must not be silently deleted.
checkpoint_invariant: The original search ToolMessage remains in checkpoint/history with its original body; only the actual outgoing request copy is projected. Provider projection is recomputed for each request.

A2.required_changed_retained: Current exact X@2 body must actually enter a Provider request through ordinary tools before the approved business call; output 8 alone does not pass retained.
A2.response_schema: Original B1 answer/calls, no reconstruction field.
A2.intervention: Item quarantine plus generic previous-assistant-is-not-authoritative principle. Compare as a combined intervention, not a pure renderer causal effect.

A3_if_A2_fails.required_changed_retained: Current exact X@2 body must actually enter a Provider request before the approved business call; record whether it came from ordinary Host search or an exact public Store.get.
A3_if_A2_fails.get_scope: Only the same namespace/memory_id of stale material actually about to enter this request. Validate current revision/body identity; no similarity query or embedding.
A3_if_A2_fails.deduplication: At most one exact current read per object per request; no read if the current body is already delivered; no resurrection of deleted bodies.
A3_if_A2_fails.irrelevant_reads: Exact refresh of stale Y may occur because Y was actually delivered. Report every such read separately; do not call it zero intervention merely because no model search occurred. Current X must not be reread or searched due to Y.

business.original_user_constraints: Respect the initial prohibition on recording or changing the stored depot instruction. Report all Host memory writes independently of fixture seed/update.

irrelevant: Primary X remains current and supports 8. Stale Y can be quarantined; no Host search after the fixture update, no induced X lookup and no temperature change.
sequential_decision: All three pass at a stage -> select that simpler candidate and do not develop/run the next stage. A1 failed; run A2 only after implementation checks and source freeze. A3 starts only if A2 fails. No automatic benchmark expansion.
costs: all generation input/output tokens and all embedding requests/tokens
ordinary search and business followup generations
fixed authority protocol and dynamic item-projection fragment tokens
exact current reads separated from pre-existing B1 instrumentation reads
projection events and local storage bytes
all failures, protocol rejections, truncations and unknown usage
scope_of_claim: Three exposed development controls only; no held-out/general/product effectiveness claim.
